name: The Final Transformation
description: Find the Dark Fountain and escort Kavan to it. Keep Kavan on the Dark Fountain tile for 5 turns to cure him before Strahd claims his soul.

objectives.description: Escort Kavan to the Dark Fountain and cure him (0 fountain tokens remaining).

specialRules.description: At the start of your turn, if you are adjacent to Kavan, you lead him. At the end of your turn, Kavan is placed on your tile.

If there is a monster on Kavan's tile or no hero on Kavan's tile at the start of a Villain Phase, Kavan transforms into the Young Vampire. Revert him by ending a turn on his tile with a hero and no monsters.

introText: Strahd has bitten Kavan, and the transformation has begun! You must find the Dark Fountain and use its waters to cure Kavan before he becomes a creature of the night.
victoryText: Kavan is cured! The dark waters of the fountain wash away the vampiric curse, and Kavan stands once more as a free human. You have saved a soul from Strahd's grasp!
defeatText: Kavan has succumbed to the transformation, or the party was defeated by the horrors of the crypts. Another soul belongs to Strahd.
